mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month decline in GDP growth below 1.5% signals weakening aggregate demand, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations deteriorate.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of triggered instances, or GDP growth rebounds above 2% within 3 months of signal activation.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the industrial production index above 2% signals accelerating manufacturing output, which historically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate profit margins expand.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of triggered instances, or industrial production growth reverts below 1% within 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals monetary tightening, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances, or the Fed cuts rates within 3 months of signal activation.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the unemployment rate above 8% signals labor market weakness, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations decline.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances, or unemployment falls below 7% within 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in retail sales below -2% signals weakening consumer demand, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate revenue growth slows.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances, or retail sales rebound above 0% within 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the housing starts index above 15% signals accelerating residential construction, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as related sectors outperform.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of triggered instances, or housing starts growth reverts below 5% within 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the CPI above 3% signals accelerating inflation, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as equity valuations contract under higher discount rates.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances, or CPI growth reverts below 2% within 3 months.
